9033.d: The Duel Arena was an ancient site where all players could go to engage in one-on-one combat.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The arena was located north-east of Al Kharid:
• A Ring of duelling teleports directly to the arena entrance.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, and then walk north-west.
• The Dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, or a Master archaeologist's outfit, teleports to Kharid-et Dig Site, then go north.
• Fire altar teleport and then go south.
